titulo: Rays to face Brewers in World Series, guaranteeing a 1st-time champion
cuerpo: Junior Caminero and Yandy Diaz each hit a two-run homer and Freddy Peralta threw 5 1/3 gritty innings as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 of the American League Championship Series on Monday night to advance to the World Series for the third time in the franchise's 29 seasons.
